t: About FMIC: Fender Musical Instruments Corporation
s: Discover the history and mission of Fender Musical Instruments Corporation, a global leader in music gear innovation.
Fender Musical Instruments Corporation (FMIC) manufactures guitars, basses, amplifiers, and other related equipment.

Fender Musical Instruments Corporation (FMIC), whose portfolio of brands includes Fender®, Squier®, Gretsch® guitars, Jackson®, EVH® and Charvel®, follows a player-centric approach to crafting the highest quality instruments and musical solutions across genres.
